| Category = Recipes for dessert

{{recipe}}
 
==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] dried assorted fruit (e.g. raisins, cherries, etc.)
*1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] brewed [[Cookbook:Tea|tea]]
*1 lb [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]], beaten
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mixed Spice|mixed spice]]
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Jam|jam]]

==Procedure==
#Soak the fruit in the tea for 24 hours
#Mix flour, sugar, egg, spice, fruit, and jam in bowl to make a [[Cookbook:Batter|batter]].
#Spoon batter into a [[Cookbook:Loaf Pan|loaf tin]] and [[Cookbook:Baking|bake]] for 45 minutes at 325°F.
#Let cool, remove from tin, and glaze with honey.
